entry.title: New: Resolution 57 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR AGREEMENT TO IMPLEMENT ELECTRONIC CITATIONS IN HAWAIʻI COUNTY

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year agreement with an estimated cost of $249,334 for the first year and $241,614.63 for years two through five to implement an electronic citation program.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 57-25 & FC-17 - 2/5/25
